findings.problem: merge rendered 'fusión' ('conflictos de fusión', 'Hay una fusión, un rebase o un cherry-pick') while es.md's kept-English list keeps merge English and the same line keeps rebase/cherry-pick English. The es corpus is mixed (ui.code_review 'fusionaste'; 'merge request' elsewhere), so this is consistency, not a meaning loss.
findings.fix: 'conflictos de merge sin resolver' / 'Hay un merge, un rebase o un cherry-pick en curso', or record 'fusión' for merge in es.md.

findings.problem: 'envía todos sus archivos de trabajo a {device}' — under the tú register 'sus' can read as a formal 'your' rather than 'the conversation's'; the English names the owner explicitly.
findings.fix: 'envía todos los archivos de trabajo de esta conversación a {device}'

findings.problem: 'Falta en {device}: {tools}' — singular verb before a list that usually names several tools.

findings.note: Mechanical checks on the committed bytes at 486ef6f270 (scratch node script with the repo's @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser; negative control: the same signature/plural-arm comparison flags a dropped argument and a foreign arm on synthetic input): key set equals English (365 keys); base 1fb3d656c3..head diff of this file is exactly the 55 added working_set_* values (0 changed, 0 removed), so every other value is bytes covered by the superseded audits; every audited value parses with the same arguments, number skeletons (::group-off) and plural arguments as English; plural arms = the locale's CLDR categories, no foreign arm; no bidi controls (U+200E/F, U+202A-E, U+2066-9, U+061C); no ASCII '...'; no value identical to English. Rendered fit NOT verified (no rendered frames in this lane; Electron launch forbidden on this host).

mesh-working-set.tsx renders the probe's raw git error line (clone_detail) verbatim in mono when it is not a fixed probe code (PROBE_CODE). That untranslated line is diagnostic terminal output (an LTR island, acceptable under the style guides); once core #4241 replaces raw detail with fixed codes, any code the UI chooses to explain in words needs new keys in all 8 locales. Not an i18n finding at this head.
